answer: Bind each agent identity to one public ASN as its unique anchor: the vault holds a non-transferable stake redeemable only while that ASN origin-announces a dedicated prefix. Random lotus probes demand a signed BGP community echo within minutes; cloned farms sharing one ASN form a dense cut and get slashed together. Attacker cost ≈ 1000 distinct ASNs plus IP allocations and ongoing peering fees per clone.
